mappings.rationale: BPS Lampiran 5 (p.134, forward 2020->2025) and Lampiran 10 (p.329, reverse 2025->2020) both render the row '01711 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Primata' -> '01700 Perburuan, Penangkapan, dan Kegiatan Jasa Terkait'. Semantic continuity confirmed at uraian level, not title alone: 01700's uraian generalizes taxon-specific capture into a single broad clause 'penangkapan satwa liar (mati atau hidup) sebagai makanan... untuk digunakan dalam penelitian, untuk ditempatkan dalam kebun binatang atau sebagai hewan kesayangan' -- the destination for primates (research/zoo/pet use is precisely the primate-capture rationale absorbed here). No primate-specific carve-out or exclusion appears anywhere in 01700's 'tidak mencakup' list, confirming absorption rather than divergence.

Both Lampiran 5 (p.134) and Lampiran 10 (p.329) render '01712 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Mamalia' -> '01700'. 01700's uraian carries mammal-specific continuity verbatim: 'penangkapan mamalia laut, seperti duyung, singa laut, dan anjing laut yang dilakukan di daratan', 'perburuan rubah, cerpelai, dan serigala untuk melindungi ternak', and 'produksi tanduk mamalia... dari kegiatan perburuan dan penangkapan'. These are not generic wildlife language but named mammal taxa/products, textually inherited from the 2020 mammal-hunting subclass now folded into the merged code.

Both Lampiran 5 (p.134) and Lampiran 10 (p.329) render '01713 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Reptil' -> '01700'. 01700's uraian explicitly retains reptile-specific product language: 'produksi kulit bulu binatang, kulit reptil atau kulit burung dari kegiatan perburuan atau penangkapan' and 'produksi tanduk mamalia dan organ reptil atau hewan lainnya dari kegiatan perburuan dan penangkapan' -- reptile skin and organ extraction, the defining activity of 2020's 01713, is named directly inside the merged 2025 uraian, not inferred from title alone.

Both Lampiran 5 (p.134) and Lampiran 10 (p.329) render '01714 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Burung' -> '01700'. 01700's uraian names bird-skin production directly: 'produksi kulit bulu binatang, kulit reptil atau kulit burung dari kegiatan perburuan atau penangkapan' -- the bird-hunting subclass's defining output (bird skin/plumage from capture) is textually present in the merged uraian, confirming a content-level absorption rather than a coincidental title match.

Both Lampiran 5 (p.134) and Lampiran 10 (p.329) render '01715 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Insekta' -> '01700'. 01700's opening general clause 'kegiatan perburuan dan penangkapan hewan dengan perangkap untuk tujuan komersial' plus the broad wildlife-capture catch-all ('penangkapan satwa liar (mati atau hidup)... untuk pengendalian populasi satwa') is taxon-agnostic and structurally designed to subsume insect trapping -- no insect-specific residual code exists elsewhere in the 2025 scheme for commercial insect hunting, and the BPS crosswalk explicitly routes it here on both directional tables, so absence of an insect-specific carve-out is evidence of intentional consolidation, not omission.

Both Lampiran 5 (p.134) and Lampiran 10 (p.329) render '01719 Perburuan dan Penangkapan Satwa Liar Lainnya' -> '01700'. 01700's uraian is itself residual/catch-all in structure ('penangkapan satwa liar (mati atau hidup) sebagai makanan... untuk pengendalian populasi satwa... perburuan untuk pengendalian populasi hewan'), directly continuing 2020's 01719 'other wild animals' residual class -- it is the natural terminus for the leftover-taxa subclass once the taxon-specific classes (primata/mamalia/reptil/burung/insekta) were also folded into the same code.

payload.notes: Evidence itself is unambiguous and strong (image-verified on both directional BPS crosswalk tables, Lampiran 5 p.134 and Lampiran 10 p.329, mutually consistent; uraian-level semantic corroboration for all six source codes, no title-similarity-only reasoning used). needs_quarantine=true is set NOT because the crosswalk evidence is thin, but because canonical.json's existing metadata mis-simplifies this MERGE: kbli_2020_source='01711' and pp28_sources=['01711'] capture only one of the six converging 2020 codes (01711/01712/01713/01714/01715/01719), and status_mapping='CODICE_RINUMERATO' (simple renumber) mischaracterizes a true 6:1 consolidation as a 1:1 rename. This is the SPLIT-trap's mirror case flagged in kbli-navigator SKILL.md Section 4.2 (multi-code correspondence collapsed to a single code) and should be corrected downstream before this record is treated as fully adjudicated. licensing_inherits=false: per_skala risk/licensing data traces to _l1_source='OSS_RBA_2025_id_version_fff4053d' (a 2025-native OSS RBA endpoint pull, oss/detail.json + oss/relasi.json confirm live OSS record uuid 625ce477-b225-57f3-a395-fd3082ac77ef), and pp28/ABSENT.json documents an explicit exhaustive-search absent verdict for source 01711 (21 PP28 lampiran files / 11,208 pages scanned, nothing found) -- so no KBLI-2020-vintage PP28 lampiran row exists to extract via D2; the licensing facts are 2025-native, not inherited.

reasons: Independently re-derived the crosswalk mapping from BOTH directional BPS PNGs before comparing to D1: lampiran5_p134-134.png (forward 2020->2025, row block 01711-01719) and lampiran10_p329-329.png (reverse 2025->2020, row block for target 01700) both visually confirm the identical set of six KBLI-2020 codes -- 01711 Primata, 01712 Mamalia, 01713 Reptil, 01714 Burung, 01715 Insekta, 01719 Satwa Liar Lainnya -- all converging on 2025 code 01700 'Perburuan, Penangkapan, dan Kegiatan Jasa Terkait'. This matches D1's six MERGE rows exactly, with no extra or missing rows on either visible page block.

Verified the uraian-level semantic-corroboration claims against canonical.json's actual uraian text: the mammal claim (01712 -> phrases 'penangkapan mamalia laut, seperti duyung, singa laut, dan anjing laut', 'perburuan rubah, cerpelai, dan serigala untuk melindungi ternak', 'produksi tanduk mamalia... dari kegiatan perburuan dan penangkapan') is verbatim-present; the reptile claim (01713 -> 'kulit reptil', 'organ reptil') is verbatim-present; the bird claim (01714 -> 'kulit burung dari kegiatan perburuan atau penangkapan') is verbatim-present. The primate (01711) and insect (01715) claims are honestly framed by D1 as inferential (research/zoo/pet clause; taxon-agnostic trapping clause) rather than verbatim, which is the correct calibration since no primate- or insect-specific token exists in the uraian -- D1 does not over-claim here.

Verified the 'tidak mencakup' exclusion list in canonical.json contains no primate- or insect-specific carve-out (only livestock-skin, pest-control, whale-hunting, slaughterhouse, sport-hunting, and hunting-support-org exclusions) -- supports D1's absorption argument rather than contradicting it.

Verified canonical.json's existing (pre-D1) metadata directly: status_mapping='CODICE_RINUMERATO', pp28_sources=['01711'], kbli_2020_source='01711', mapping_note referencing only 01711 -- confirms D1's stated basis for needs_quarantine=true (a true 6:1 MERGE mischaracterized in the record as a simple 1:1 renumber, capturing only one of six converging source codes).

Verified the licensing_inherits=false chain independently: canonical.json's _l1_source field reads 'OSS_RBA_2025_id_version_fff4053d'; oss/detail.json independently confirms the same live OSS record ('_id':'625ce477-b225-57f3-a395-fd3082ac77ef', matching judul/uraian for 01700 exactly); pp28/ABSENT.json documents an exhaustive absent verdict for source 01711 with files_scanned=[394930..394950] (21 files, arithmetically confirmed) and pages_scanned_total=11208, both numbers matching D1's citation exactly. Since no PP28-2020-vintage lampiran text exists to inherit from, and the source tag is explicitly 2025-native OSS, licensing_inherits=false is the evidentially correct conclusion.

Caveat noted but NOT treated as a refutation of D1's specific claim: the pp28 exhaustive search was scoped only to source code 01711, not the other five merged 2020 codes (01712/13/14/15/19); and the OSS evidence actually captured (oss/detail.json, oss/relasi.json) contains only judul/uraian/category-hierarchy data, not the per_skala risk/licensing table itself, so the ultimate provenance of that specific table content (which reads unusually veterinary-service-flavored for a hunting/capture code) is not independently re-confirmable from this evidence bundle alone. This is a residual gap already implicitly covered by D1's own needs_quarantine=true flag, not a contradiction of the stated non-inheritance-from-PP28-2020 conclusion.

Cross-checked a potential red herring: the crosswalk image footers show printed page numbers 120 and 315, not the locator-cited 134/329 -- but both images share the identical +14 offset (134-120=14, 329-315=14), consistent with a fixed front-matter offset between the combined PDF's absolute page index (used correctly as the locator) and the Lampiran's internal printed pagination. This is expected PDF-locator behavior, not an evidence-integrity problem.
